findings.title: Defer dynamic imports until the corresponding app is requested
findings.body: Each import() is executed immediately when the app-store registry is evaluated, so importing the registry still starts loading and evaluating every app, including apps unused by the request. This does not provide on-demand loading and adds concurrent chunk loading to cold starts. Store loader functions and invoke only the selected loader instead. It also avoids leaving rejected imports for unused apps without a rejection handler.

findings.title: Await the async reschedule cleanup callbacks
findings.body: The new async callback is passed to forEach, which discards its returned promise. In particular, failures while importing or constructing the calendar in getCalendar now become rejected promises that the surrounding try/catch cannot catch; previously synchronous calendar-construction errors were caught there. Reschedule can report success with cleanup still running or failed, and these failures can produce unhandled rejections. Await a mapped Promise.all (or use an awaited loop) inside the try/catch. The same change is needed in packages/app-store/wipemycalother/lib/reschedule.ts.
